issues: No prices are printed anywhere in the three sources (food docx and drinks xlsx): every priceUsd is null.
Food source lines 17-18 (allergy warning) repeat after each of 7 sections; stored once in footnotes. Serving notes are in both footnotes and the category note.
Source has ligature characters (bonﬁle, Proﬁterol, Proﬁteroles); normalized to plain 'fi'.

Option lines ('* Tercihinize göre...') appended to Sezar Salatası (after ' — ') and to Krep / Pankek / Waffle (no description, so the option text is the whole detail); the Krep line could also be read as a dessert-category note.

Item names that use ' / ' instead of ' | ': only 'Kulüp Sandviç / Club Sandwich' (split on ' / '). Single-name items printed once (Katsu Sando, Hamburger, Cheeseburger, Royal Burger, Tiramisu, Cheesecake, Penne all’Arrabbiata, Fettuccine Alfredo) have tr=en.
Items Tereyağlı Karides Tava, Merit Royal Baklava, Taze Mevsim Meyveleri have no description line.
Starters Kalamar Tava, Viyana Şnitzeli, Tavuk Fingers: the 'served with' phrase is on one bilingual line ('TR | EN'), stored as detailTr/detailEn.

Drinks xlsx has no food-style TR/EN descriptions: cocktail ingredient lines are English for International Cocktails (detailEn) and Turkish for Signature Cocktails (detailTr); signature names are English-only so tr=en.

Drinks structure is ambiguous: 'SODA / MINERAL WATER' might be a heading for SAN PELLEGRINO, treated as its own item; 'MEYVE SUYU / FRUIT JUICE' and 'FRESH MEYVE SUYU / FRESH FRUIT JUICE' (juice lists) are nested as sub-categories of MEŞRUBATLAR, flavour lines zipped TR to EN one-to-one.

Duplicate heading 'FRESH MEYVE SUYU / FRESH FRUIT JUICE' appears twice with different flavour lists: under soft drinks (Portakal, Greyfurt, Havuç, Elma) and as its own block after HOT DRINKS (Greyfurt, Elma, Karpuz, Kavun, Kivi, Portakal, Karışık). Kept both. The second block is probably a smoothie/fresh-juice list that sits under HOT DRINKS in the spreadsheet by layout only.

BRITVIC flavours (TOMATO, BITTER LEMON, GINGER ALE, TONIC) are one line; stored as detailEn, not split into items. 'ICE TEA (PEACH, LEMON)' kept as a single item. 'SU / WATER 330 ml.' stored as 'SU 330 ml.' / 'WATER 330 ml.'; likewise 750 ml.

Source typos kept verbatim: BLOODY MARRY, CAIRPIRINHA, LYNCBURG, TOBASCO, WORCHESTER, APREROL, ANGUSTURO, VOTKA (cocktail ingredients), 'GI' (likely GIN, Long Island), NENE YAPRAKLARI (likely NANE), HİBÜSKÜS EKŞİSİ, GRANDE ABSENTH, APERATİFLER / APERATIVES, 'ICE TEA'. Menu section 'Pool & Beach Beverage Menu' title line is not a category.
MALT category includes LAGAVULIN DE 1995 16 Y.O. as printed; no sizes/volumes (cl) or 'ml' columns exist except water.
MANTI: new menu calls it 'El Yapımı Mantı'; 2025 menu had 'Türkmen mantısı' (likely the same item renamed).
